entries.description: Reviewed the completed accessibility-and-stubbing closeout, accepted stub guide, accessibility evidence, the current /platform/stub implementation, the Phase 2 roadmap, and all remaining Phase 2 session-set specs through routed analysis, then created docs/planning/stubbed-uat-scope-ledger.md to freeze the early-UAT baseline.

Confirmed that the mature human-review scope is the /platform/stub route plus its shell, workspace, query-page, detail-target, prompt, and report-viewer navigation paths, and explicitly deferred business-logic, distributor-reframe, multi-organization, representative E2E, and later full-app UAT concerns to their planned session sets.

Recorded that Session 1 found no new safe cross-set overlap beyond the accepted sequential Phase 2 queue, while confirming that Session 2 checklist authoring and lightweight reviewer-harness preparation may proceed in parallel once the frozen scope is accepted. No downstream spec edits were required.

Updated docs/session-sets/stubbed-uat/spec.md and finalized docs/planning/stubbed-uat-scope-ledger.md so the set now has an explicit Session 1 artifact, reviewer issue-capture fields, severity and status buckets, and durable exit criteria for the later checklist and findings work.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build sequentially. Build succeeded with the repo's existing 11 CS1591 XML-doc warnings in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Services/DevEmailInbox.cs, and all 381 tests passed across the seven test projects.

Sent the Session 1 spec context, the new stubbed-uat scope ledger, the spec update, the current activity-log entries, git diff, and the sequential build/test evidence to external session verification and saved the raw review output. The verifier returned VERIFIED with no blocking issues.

Verified the Session 1 prerequisites still exist, routed the Session 2 checklist/harness design through ai-router as a documentation task, and created docs/session-sets/stubbed-uat/stubbed-uat-checklist.json with a machine-readable reviewMode boundary, issue-capture metadata, defer rules, and ten concrete review items tied directly to the frozen /platform/stub scope.

Created docs/session-sets/stubbed-uat/reviewer-guide.md with quick-start launch instructions, checklist-reading guidance, issue-capture rules, and explicit in-scope versus out-of-scope guardrails for the early stub-backed review pass.

Added a dedicated Stub UAT launch profile to src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/Properties/launchSettings.json that opens /platform/stub directly and explicitly enables PlatformStubMode in Development, giving reviewers a lightweight repeatable harness without introducing a heavier script workflow.

Updated docs/planning/reusable-platform-stub-guide.md to point to the Session 2 reviewer assets and structured the checklist plus reviewer guide so manual-only observations, shared automation-backed checks, and deferred out-of-scope observations are clearly separated for Session 3 follow-through.

Ran dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln and dotnet test Dabbler.Platform.sln --no-build sequentially. Build succeeded with the repo's existing 11 CS1591 XML-doc warnings in src/Libs/Dabbler.Security/Services/DevEmailInbox.cs plus the SDK's preview NETSDK1057 informational messages, and all 381 tests passed across the seven test projects.

Sent the Session 2 spec context, new checklist and reviewer assets, launch-profile update, stub-guide update, current activity-log entries, git diff, and the successful build/test evidence to external session verification and saved the raw review output. The verifier returned VERIFIED with only non-blocking minor observations.
